Supersedes the PR #9 proposal (balance/v5/policy-diversity-protocol.json, kept for the record).
question: Do the balance patterns observed so far survive a change of the policy that generates the observations?
scope: Engine-based self-play and cross-play with three policies. Policy-level findings describe a policy. Robustness across these three policies is evidence about this policy family, never a proof that the rules are balanced or imbalanced, and says nothing about human players.

policies.ev-k1.1: corrected reference, server/balance/v5/evk11.ts (ev-k1 + C1 cell ties, C2 reply-state ordering, C3 near-ties < 1e-7, C4 planning with the executor's own move model, no planning noise). ev-k1 and its V4.2 evidence stay frozen and are not measurements of ev-k1.1
policies.oa-v2: opponent-aware maximin on ev-k1.1's move model, server/balance/v5/policies.ts
policies.softmax-v2: bounded Top-k softmax over ev-k1.1's ranked candidates, k 4, T 1.3255, floor 0.02, public-seed sampling

executor: All three policies execute moves with ev-k1.1's greedy11 (nextMoves11), the same move model each uses in planning. Re-planning only after a teleport has resolved.

seeds.crossPlay: 68031-68040 x each policy on each side x each first mover

metrics: server/balance/v5/metrics.ts: first-mover and Human-side decisive win rates (Wilson + seed-blocked bootstrap), length (mean, median, turn-limit), counterplay (lead changes, comebacks), turn-2 captures, coverage (distinct two-turn openings, distinct turn-1 placements, opening entropy, effective openings, largest share, placement signatures, effect entropy), cross-play strength (seed-blocked, by role), planner/executor agreement in the real games, teleport foresight (information fairness), integrity (illegal, errors, softlocks, replay).

uncertainty.gameLevel: seed-blocked bootstrap, 5000 resamples: self-play blocks are the 2 games of a seed (both first movers), cross-play blocks the 4 games of a seed (each policy on each side x each first mover)
uncertainty.policyDependence: differences between self-play arms paired by seed (68001-68030 shared), seed-blocked bootstrap
uncertainty.openingClusters: sensitivity / coverage diagnostic only; NOT_ESTIMABLE when fewer than 5 clusters

decisionRules.policyDependence: a metric is POLICY-DEPENDENT between two policies if the paired seed-blocked 95% interval of their difference excludes 0
decisionRules.openingCoverage: reported per policy; not a gate
decisionRules.eligibility: a policy is eligible for robustness claims if every game replays, it has 0 illegal moves / errors / softlocks, plan-execution agreement is 1.0 in its games, and (for non-reference policies) its decisions differed from the reference in the preflight
decisionRules.ruleRobustness: edge = rate - 0.5 per eligible policy (seed-blocked). ROBUST ACROSS THE ELIGIBLE POLICIES if every eligible policy's interval lies beyond +0.05 (or every one beyond -0.05); POLICY-DEPENDENT if one lies beyond 0.05 and another within +-0.05 or beyond on the other side; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise; INSUFFICIENT POLICIES with fewer than 2 eligible
decisionRules.noProof: No result from these three policies is described as proof that the rules are universally balanced or imbalanced.
